steps.text: My head, poor head... what makes this clamor now... hm?
Ah... it was a folk song of bamboo, clapping away.
He shelves his game, knows not of ages' change. From dreams I wake, ask only of the years... what years... what years...
Urgh...
Why is my wine gone?
What cruelty is this.
Shang Zhong feels at the herbal plaster on his neck, as is his habit.
His ten years taking up his pole every day, climbing up and down the mountain, was his habit too.
Qujiang Peak is incontestably tall and perilous. So tall it lacks any human habitation, so perilous not a sound can be heard.
He's lost count of how many springtimes he's now passed in Shangshu. He raises his head to look afar, and at the end of a pass with no human's former trace, he sees but one person.
A person who has been waiting for him, for a very long time.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: ...In the end, we meet again.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: We only just met.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You didn't have your blade then, so we didn't meet.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Well, I've brought it now.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'll be clear.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I know the fault isn't yours. I also know, that rainy night, it wasn't just my son who died.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Of course you know.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You took in his daughter. How is she now?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I plan for her to continue my work.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Your work as an escort? Or do you want her comfortable as an innkeeper, like you've been these past years?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Either or. Whatever she likes.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Has she found a sweetheart?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Not yet.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: A shame.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You won't live to see the day she becomes a bride.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Maybe we don't need to jump to the killing today?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Impossible. I know how you are. Your heart is heavy, but mine holds a grudge.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: A grudge of ten years.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: So you never planned to win against me today. The restaurants, teahouses, inns, aren't they all ways out to leave to your daughter?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You know the escort is a profession of wrongs. You also know the state the escorts will be in, with you gone.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Don't forget. You've gone outside the rules, with a blade strapped to you. People will sympathize with you. But by reason, you'll still be a traitor.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: If you bore the guilt and led the escorts onward after that night, how could I be betraying it?!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: My son walked that path. How could I not know? But your actions, opening inns and restaurants? Aren't you trampling upon their deaths?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It was you! You fell at a stroke, and ran from your past!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I did... I know that. But we've said a little more than enough now.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I am Head of the Xingyu Escort Assocation, Asker to the Frost, Zheng Qingyue.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: ...Polearm of the Shangs, Shang Zhong.
In early spring, twilight approaches. The trees' shadows sway, the fallen snow like silver.
A gust of wind blows, and a blade falls.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You've rested far too long, Zheng Qingyue.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: It might not be my rest. Maybe you've climbed too many mountains, improved your footwork again.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It's hard to know.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: But heroes like you are doomed to spend your older years unable to walk. It's such a shame.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: So your blade flowed quick, the snow's gleam hit my eyes, you cut open my trouser leg, and you think now I can't walk?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You won't be able to block the next slash. That pole isn't any family treasure, you know. It's nothing but a stick of lousy bamboo.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —Dad!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ye?! What are you...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: So you were Du Yaoye after all. In the blink of an eye, you've grown so tall...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You two are quite free, if it's getting dark and you still have the time to be... practicing kung fu here.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: It's you. What are you doing here?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'll tell you straight, Master Shang. My friend tasked me to find that goblet on your belt. I'm looking for a pavilion, and I just can't do without that cup.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I worry, see, since swords don't discriminate. If you... glanced off of it in your scuffle, it'd hardly be worth it when the dust settles.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Dad, what are you even doing—!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Ten years ago, the Xingyu Escort Association took on a great commission. But heavy rains came on the way, and they were attacked by bandits in the wild.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: To protect the goods, Zheng Qingyue abandoned his fellow escorts. A dozen brothers were killed. Among them was my son, and your... blood father.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Zheng Qingyue let them die without trying. Not only did he let them die, he didn't protect the goods in the end. He didn't protect the escorts' reputation.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: And after all that, he even turned a blind eye to their decline, and fled from his failure. Did you know that?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: After that, your mother left Shangshu, and went back to her home.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Du Yaoye... Can you swear you knew any of this?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ye. This has nothing to do with you. Your dad's going to—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Then you're... Master Shang.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: The traitor Shang Zhong.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Who the hell do you think I am? You think I spent all my life sheltered like some clueless idiot?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Yeah, I knew all about my mom and dad. I know better than you what old Zheng's done all these years and how he's done it.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: And that's precisely why I need to tell you two today—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —Association this and inn that, they'll all be Du's sooner or later.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Now, if you two oldies can stop making trouble for me.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: If you don't step aside, you'll regret it.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If you've got something to say, say it...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: A coin-sword?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You're joking. Are you going to cast some kind of magic in front of me or something?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Ah, excuse me, now, I'm not handy in close combat at all... it's just...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: If you really want this thing, then take it. Catch.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: ––Hold it!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Zheng Qingyue! No more distractions!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —Don't touch my dad!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Rngh! Out of the way!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ye!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Shang Zhong, you've lost it! Using violence on the young!
A clang.
A sweep of the pole holds back the sharp gleam, but without obstruction, Zheng Qingyue's blade now sweeps elsewhere.
And that goblet proves its sturdiness again, for how could earthenware anywhere take a strike from Zheng Qingyue's blade without a stroke of harm?
But with that strike, that goblet, black as the night, is sent flying away.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: —The cup!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Just leave us! Go do your thing!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But you're...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: This is family business!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Just hold on for a bit, I'll be right there.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ye, don't let him go!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: This stupid old man wants your life and you're still obsessed with that lousy thing!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Du Yaoye is right. Ten years ago, you lost this goblet on a mountain ridge. Now, you've lost it again. How does it feel?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Shang Zhong...!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: If you want me aside, the answer's simple.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: This is far enough!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Mr. Zheng!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: —The goblet's been knocked down the cliff. That Lungmenite's already after it. Move it, both of you!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Thank you, sir.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Taihe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: —Cheh.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Miss Du, what's your business here?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I'm not letting you go.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: There's been Mr. Liang and that Lee man and both of you impossible-looking mandarins, and—

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: After all my bystanding, I've finally gotten things straight.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Besides, I made an agreement with Lee. We value our promises, and that's how it works.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Ye! Enough troublemaking!

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: ...What a gaggle.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: There shouldn't have been this many people today. But no matter...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Having you is enough to settle things.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: —Tch!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Miss Du, you should know we handle affairs impartially.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I don't think you're all that 'impartial.'

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Please, step aside.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Then you'll have to excuse me!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Now, now, don't be hasty! It won't do for a great lord like you to be meting out such force on a young girl, will it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: —The Yin-ch'ing Fan of the Liens. As fine a kung fu as expected.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Ingrate.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Lord Zuo, are you alright?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ugh! Ow-ow-ow... It's truly fearsome you should throw such vast bricks with ease.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You had your chance. No excuses.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Crossbow bolts! Who was that?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Here I am. You're looking the wrong way.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Don't get in the way, rabbit.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So Rhodes Island doesn't intend on assisting the Sui Regulator?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We don't.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Maybe your compass points the same way as ours, but Nian and us have gotten on for a long while. I know her character in and out.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: A beast's heart is hardly fathomed. What can her character be worth?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Maybe not much else, for all I know. But at the very least, it's worth me.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: And me. Dusk tore my confusion with a stroke, and gave me what I'll describe as a blunt awakening... I might like to stand to the side of things, but the occasion's fine, and I know to pay a grace back.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: The Lien clan's Yin-ch'ing Fan.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You gave me a good scare last time, rooted me straight to the spot. Much thanks for the opportunity now, yes, much thanks.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: If you want to fight over your cup, get lost before you do.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: This goblet has huge significance to the Association. If I could just leave it like that, I may as well be dead, you understand?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You may as well be dead right now.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Good, good, good. That's the look of Zheng Qingyue. Is it because your daughter's here, or because of your escort prestige?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: You always were someone who wanted to live on. Now our battle finally has meaning.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Shang Zhong.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: If your son in spirit knew what you were doing today, would he be happy?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Don't you throw that concept at me. Even if he was alive here and now, he wouldn't be able to hold back his father!

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Master Shen, why are you here?

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I sent those few people to the top, and came back down. I thought I'd run into you eventually, Mr. Liang.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: So you're making your way too?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's been a while since I came. I'm taking a look around the vicinity.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: How about Miss Ning?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: She's aware, or perhaps was long since aware.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: The theft in the study was her own devising, likely.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: You'd better try and appease her, sir, please.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: Forget all the others, you can't ever let that old Bai potter wade into the fight.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Tianshi Bai...

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: If he calls a strike of lightning down, he'll have blasted straight over the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of Rites. We don't know where the Tianshi stand on this.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I thank you for your concern, Master Shen.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *Sigh*... I'm only a boatman, for all my concern is.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: I guarded the north for a few years. I chatted with the other soldiers, talking home and the times and so on, throughout all the cold days with nothing to do.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: We all devoted out hearts to Yan, but a little foolishness here and there hardly needed to get away from us.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Such is the prudence of the ordinary man.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: That's what I am. Aren't you too, Mr. Liang?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: The land is vast and wide, all things free. Under heaven's infinity, all are ordinary men.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: *Sigh*... What do you hope for me to do?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I hope you'll protect the peace and safety of Shangshu, Master Shen. If any setbacks should happen in the end... I hope you'll leap in to pacify the dispute, before Miss Ning and the other five act.

steps.name: Boatman
steps.text: There's the old saying. Ultimately, human affairs all depend on heaven's mandate.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: A shame.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: This is the first adage I learned from Yan's court: 'Heaven's mandate lies in man.'
